items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: And Ronnie Zito came in, took his place. ... We did an Ed Sullivan Show with him playing ... Ronnie Zito drums

ctx.x: And Ronnie Zito came in, took his place. He did a great job but he was not a Jake Hanna you know. He learned actually. We did an Ed Sullivan Show with him playing my favorite [scats]. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
